title: Metric-Differential-Tree UTN and Context-Bound Token Intelligence
description: Metric-Differential-Tree UTN and Context-Bound Token Intelligence (MDT-UTN-CBT) presents an algorithmic framework for converting context into explicit structural identity, Universal Typing and Naming (UTN), Context-Bound Tokens (CBT), and reusable context-addressed intelligence. The framework represents target context through GenericContainerStarmap, organizes structural similarity and difference through a Metric-Differential Tree (MDT), and applies Per-Node UTN Intelligence for typing-first and naming-second structural decisions. It further introduces Context-Bound Tokens using the canonical notation token@context, Baseline-Preserved Context Injection for controlled measurement of explicit context influence, and Context-as-Address as a reusable structural interface for search, caching, Delta Intelligence, CCC, Brain-Unit dispatch, validation, and structural growth. Version 1.0.0 is an Algorithmic Foundation Release focused on the structural model, algorithmic invariants, validation methodology, and future runtime architecture.
notes: MDT-UTN-CBT v1.0.0 is an Algorithmic Foundation Release. It defines the context-first MDT-UTN architecture, Context-Bound Token representation, baseline-preserved context validation, Context-as-Address runtime model, and associated validation protocols. The release intentionally emphasizes algorithms, invariants, and experimental methodology rather than a full executable runtime.
